description: Collection state: count, server.mode, sample entries, tag (membershipKind, match=), name, noun, URL pattern, layout, where listed, post fields used. Pass status/q/cursor/limit (any one, even empty) for an items[] page instead: draft = never published; published with unpublished edits = hasChanges:true (staged title/date/tags/author); scheduled = future visibleAt. limit 1-200, default 50.

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

prefix.description: Collection id or prefix, e.g. "posts" or "blog/", exactly as list_collections returned it.

status.description: Filter items[] by status (meanings in the tool description). This or q/cursor/limit makes the answer include items[].

name: inspect_collection
